name: hoard
description: Hoard: encrypted multi-Git sync for Obsidian

scripts.build: node esbuild.config.mjs production && cp manifest.json dist/plugin/
scripts.build:decrypter: bun build src/decrypter/bin.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/decrypter/hoard-decrypt && bun build src/decrypter/bin.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile dist/decrypter/hoard-decrypt.exe
